descriptions.history_list: List the ComfyUI server's completed prompt records, newest last. Optional: max_items caps how many records come back. Each record carries its status (status_str, completed), the messages array holding execution_start / execution_success / execution_error timestamps in milliseconds, and the outputs map — that timestamp pair is the only honest source of per-prompt duration. Use history_get when you already have a prompt_id. This history lives in the server's RAM and is destroyed on every restart, so read it before restarting.
descriptions.queue_clear: Clear pending work from the ComfyUI render queue. Send clear: true to wipe every pending item, or delete: ["<prompt_id>", ...] to drop specific pending prompts; a call carrying neither field posts an empty body and the server does nothing. This does NOT stop the prompt already executing — use queue_interrupt for that. Call queue_get first to see what is actually pending.
descriptions.objectinfo_all: List every node class registered on the running server together with its full input schema. This is the authority on valid class_type strings and on the COMBO option values a loader will actually accept — a graph that names a class or value absent here fails validation. Takes no parameters and returns the entire schema keyed by class name, which on a real box is over a thousand classes; prefer objectinfo_get when you already know which class you need.
descriptions.view_get: Fetch one file the server produced or holds by name. Required: filename. Optional: subfolder, and type — one of output, input, or temp, which selects the directory the name is resolved against. Returns that file's contents, so send it to a path rather than into a transcript. Use history_get or the outputs a prompt reported to learn the filename and subfolder to pass here.
